title: Card 5: inbox me sirf aakhri 800 tweet (purane kaato). Soye user ka inbox 30 din me khud mit jaata (TTL)

boxes.title: Inbox (Redis)
lines: soya user: 30 din me inbox mita

callouts.red: Pehle har inbox me saari id thi, soye hue users ki bhi

callouts.green: Soye 40 crore logon ka inbox bhi RAM khaata. Kharcha badhta, dikkat wahi
Copy sambhal leti. Copy bhi gayi to kuch request mana karo aur inbox dheere-dheere DB se bharo

callouts.red: Arpan 2 mahine baad aaya, uska inbox mit chuka
callouts.green: Follow kiye logon ke taaze tweet khinch ke (pull) inbox dobara bana do

callouts.red: Arpan 800 ke aage scroll kare? Tab Tweet store (DB) se laao, bahut kam log itna neeche jaate.
callouts.green: Agla page: page number nahi, aakhri dikhe tweet ka time do (cursor): "isse purane 50"

kyun: RAM me sirf id rakho, aur sirf aakhri 800. Jo 1 mahine se nahi aaya uska inbox mita do. Arpan ka inbox na mile to DB se bana lo: ek baar dheema, par galat nahi
peeche: card 4 me garam tweet RAM me, DB tak sirf ek request
ab: Shaam ko Redis alert: 50 crore inbox, RAM bhar rahi
agla: ab tweet hi itne ho gaye ki DB me nahi aate (card 6)
